name: Hunan Yuneng New Energy Battery Material Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hunan Yuneng New Energy Battery Material Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of lithium-ion battery cathode materials in China and internationally. The company offers high-energy lithium iron phosphate, energy storage lithium iron phosphate, polycrystalline ternary materials, and single-crystal ternary materials. Its products are used in power, energy storage, and other lithium-ion batteries, as well as new energy vehicles and other applications. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Xiangtan, China.
